title: Handley Page Halifax MZ519
squadron: NO. 578/ SQUADRON OF THE ROYAL AIR FORCE
memorial_details: Elaborate montage comprising RAF and Squadron badges; commemoration; images of crew, aircraft and stone of remembrance; and parts of the crashed aircraft. The memorial is surrounded by an elaborate, oaken, glazed frame
inscription: HALIFAX BOMBER MEMORIAL/ ON THE EVENING OF JULY 6TH 1944 A HANDLEY PAGE HAILFAX AIRCRAFT, MZ519 LK-U OF NO. 578/ SQUADRON OF THE ROYAL AIR FORCE, CRASHED ON THE OUTSKIRTS OF THE VILLAGE OF FARNSFIELD WITH THE LOSS/ OF ALL SEVEN MEMBERS OF THE CREW/ THE AIRCRAFT WAS RETURNING TO ITS HOME BASE AT BURN IN YORKSHIRE ON COMPLETION OF ITS MISSION TO/ CROIXDALLE IN NORTHERN FRANCE WHERE THE SQUADRON HAD ATTACKED ONE OF THE LAUNCHING SITES FROM/ WHICH THE V1 "FLYING BOMBS" WERE BEING DIRECTED TOWARDS LONDON./ THE 50TH ANNIVERSARY WAS COMMEMORATED BY THE DEDICATION OF A MEMORIAL AND THE PLANTING OF A/ COPSE NEAR THE SPOT WHERE THE AIRCRAFT FELL. A SPECIAL SERVICE WAS HELD IN THIS CHURCH TO MARK THE/ OCCASION./ THIS TRIBUTE WAS MADE POSSIBLE BY THE GENEROUSITY OF RELATIVES OF THE CREW, FRIENDS, SERVICE ASSOCIAIONS AND MANY PEOPLE OF THE VILLAGE.
community_connection: the village of Farnsfield where the crash occurred
